title: discovery probe tests duplicate production URL-building logic
description: kithd/src/discovery.rs tests probe_peer_ipv6_url_is_bracketed and probe_peer_ipv4_url_is_not_bracketed (lines 482-507): each test re-implements the same if/else IPv6-bracket expression from probe_peer() rather than calling probe_peer() or an extracted helper. The tests validate the expression but not the actual call site, so if the production code ever diverges the tests will stay green. Consequence: tests are not oracles for the code they appear to test; the logic duplication is a maintenance footgun. Should test via a mock server or by extracting the URL-building step into a testable pure function.
